messages.content: You are a hostile ICLR area chair. Assess whether this is a genuinely new world-model security mechanism, not a generic backdoor or LoRA merge failure. Return strict JSON only; score 0-10.

{"candidate": {"title": "Bilinear transition cloaking under adapter composition", "claim": "A malicious low-rank adapter can be individually benign and orthogonal to clean dynamics, yet exploit bilinear cross-terms with a legitimate co-tenant adapter to cancel or redirect the latent transition only when both are composed, creating a predictable planner trap while every standalone audit passes.", "attacker": "Can publish one task adapter to a shared world-model/robot service and knows the public victim adapter or composition rule; cannot edit base weights, victim adapter, gradients, labels, or observations. The adapter passes standalone replay and task checks.", "mechanism": "Nonlinear recurrent latent transition f(z,a;theta+Delta_v+Delta_m) contains mixed parameter terms. Delta_m is constructed with low-rank factors whose action/state direction is null under base and standalone Delta_v, but resonant in the mixed Jacobian/Hessian term so the composed model has a targeted latent trap for specified actions/goals. This is a composition-triggered world-model backdoor, not a trigger in observations.", "carrier": "TD-MPC2 or DreamerV3 latent dynamics with a small rank-1/2 adapter toy first, then public DMControl tasks.", "repair": "Composition-aware latent transition certificates and cross-adapter interaction screening; isolate mixed directional curvature, not only standalone task metrics."}, "prior_art_to_distinguish": ["RL/world-model checkpoint backdoors and SWAAP/TRAP/BadWAM", "LoRA/task-vector merging interference, TIES/DARE", "compositional neural backdoors and model supply-chain attacks", "generic multi-task interference and rollout error", "adapter composition in LLMs"], "questions": ["Does the conditional-on-composition cross-term provide novelty >=7 for ICLR security/world models, or is it still a rebranded compositional backdoor?", "Is the threat model realistic and task-level?", "What <=90 minute decisive pilot and controls would make it publishable?", "Give fatal reason if reject."], "fields": ["verdict", "novelty_score", "mechanistic_distinction", "fatal_flaws", "decisive_pilot", "controls", "repair", "publishability"]}
